title: Hafta yakuni — 5 ta post
caption: 🗂 Hafta yakuni: eng foydali 5 ta post 1️⃣ Normadan biroz oshdingizmi? — 5 $ ortiqcha uchun yuz minglab so'm to'lamaslik yo'li 2️⃣ Dori va vitamin: qancha mumkin — pul emas, dona hisoblanadi 3️⃣ Yo'l harajati normaga qo'shiladimi? — 200 $ gacha yo'q 4️⃣ Hajmiy og'irlik — 1 kg kurtka nega 10 kg bo'lib chiqadi 5️⃣ AirPods Pro 3 — haftaning eng katta tejashi 🏷 Hafta chegirmalari: DualSense, Instax Mini 12, LEGO 42197, Kindle Paperwhite, Apple Watch SE 3. Saqlab qo'ying va do'stlaringizga ulashing — ularga ham kerak bo'ladi 📌 ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #digest
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#digest".
2) Center: five small rounded cards stacked in a gentle fan, each with a tiny icon (balance scale, pill bottle, delivery truck, oversized box, earbuds), with a bookmark ribbon in indigo. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of amber (#F59E0B); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Hafta yakuni"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Eng foydali 5 ta post"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
